Sac de confinement d'incendie

High-temperature-resistant bag used on board to isolate and contain lithium battery or PED fires until landing.

Questions and answers

What is Sac de confinement d'incendie?

In this glossary, Sac de confinement d'incendie refers to: High-temperature-resistant bag used on board to isolate and contain lithium battery or PED fires until landing.

How is Sac de confinement d'incendie used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cabine vers cockpit : téléphone passager en surchauffe et feu ; appareil placé dans le sac de confinement incendie, refroidi à l’eau, plus de fumée visible."

Definition

High-temperature-resistant bag used on board to isolate and contain lithium battery or PED fires until landing.

Operational example

Cabin to flight deck: passenger phone overheated and ignited; device placed inside fire containment bag, cooling with water spray, no visible smoke now.

Localized term

Sac de confinement d'incendie

Localized example
